Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
RUN VARIABILITY (observed): room contents and layouts vary between runs—extra rocks, rock corridors, spiky rock rings forming around enemies, and new enemies spawning mid-visit (hub and boss room both showed repeated spawns). Treat prior room maps as approximate and re-verify each run.

CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrows fire/set facing; key+arrow combos strafe-fire in independent directions (confirmed repeatedly, e.g. w+Left, d+Down). E places bombs (left-click doesn't). Space uses active item (no visible effect with Match Stick or with a red-X/Tech-X-like icon). Q card use unconfirmed. Movement approx: 0.1s≈40px, 0.3s≈120px, 0.4s≈160px, 0.5s≈200px. Inputs occasionally drop—retry or test single axes. Door/hatch/trapdoor transitions need centered overlap on BOTH x and y PLUS 2–3 repeated presses; sometimes step out and re-enter. HYPOTHESIS (strong, still partly confounded): exits stay locked while enemies are alive—hub hatches/doors failed during waves, and the boss-room trapdoor never opened across many aligned down presses while fatties lived.

PLAYER: sprite renders inconsistently (white skull-head, cream blob, crying white head, pink blob, hidden behind/under large rocks or fatties). Confirm identity by moving/firing; the central rock cross can fully hide the sprite.

HUD/PICKUPS: hearts go hollow after damage; blue/soul hearts from blue pill. Counters for coins/keys/bombs; two item/card slots; top-right icon stack. All-hollow (0 filled) hearts still allowed many interactive turns (movement and firing worked 8+ turns) though death typically followed—keep acting until a result screen. Pickups register on touch and may lag a step. Silent inert floor objects are scenery. Poop sometimes hides items. Some crates damage on contact. A pedestal can re-grant TECH X.

TEARS (observed): travel straight, blue splash on impact; must match target's x or y within roughly 15–40px—offsets of ~20–25px caused misses in this run. Plain tears killed gray-faces, white-faced shelled enemies, and eventually chipped fatties to death (took very many volleys). Tears are blocked by rock boulders/rock piles/central rock cross; reposition vertically/horizontally to clear lanes rather than firing into walls. Enemy orbs can intercept tears mid-flight.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear, red X impact, radius ~140–150px; blocks own line of fire; point-blank unsafe. Damages fatties, gray-faces, shelled enemies, flies, spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings, TNT barrels, crates, or rock clusters; embedded eye-faces survive (invulnerable). Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK; 2 OF SPADES) replaced the active item; after Match Stick the ring bursts stopped (unconfirmed). Current loadout at death unknown.

ENEMIES (observed): winged flies tanky, chase/fire tears. Gray-faced enemies slow until enraged (open black mouth/red eyes) then charge/dash; they can take a hardshell form that is immune—wait and fire on emergence. Shelled white-faced enemies emerge from spiky rock piles, fire blue/green orbs, retreat into shell (immune), leave green damaging clouds; never linger. White round creatures burst into splashes spawning flies/other enemies. Fats (pink/white/gray-faced/red-eyed) extremely tanky, enrage with red aura/open mouth, chase relentlessly; contact drained 2 hearts in seconds. Black spiders cluster, deadly close. Spiky rock rings form around an enemy as an attack wind-up and explode outward—step out first, don't stand inside.

HAZARDS: persistent green spiky clouds, poison puddles, brazier flames, loose enemy orbs, falling sack teardrops (gilded sack with fly). All damage on contact.

NAVIGATION (per-run approximate): Tutorial room ('BASEMENT I', MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM paintings): top hatch↔brown rock hub; bottom trapdoor↔brazier room; right dark riveted door↔dark stone room. Brown rock hub: top hatch↔TNT room; bottom trapdoor↔tutorial; left gold-framed keyhole door↔shop (unreliable—see below). TNT room: two isolated barrels mid-room flank a safe central vertical gap (~x≈640–700); left-wall TNT stack; inert gray crates; bomb-bug idles left; top hatch↔boss room; bottom trapdoor↔hub. Boss room: central rock cross blocks fire lanes (and can hide player); left dark statue with red glow (invulnerable); embedded eye-faces in right rock wall (invulnerable); gilded sack with fly on right firing teardrops; card on floor bottom-right; two fatties roam and can respawn/transform; bottom trapdoor↔TNT room; no other exit; very punishing. Brazier room: four damaging corner braziers; chest inside solid rock ring is inert and bombs/Tech X failed; enter ring via left-lower diagonal gap with small diagonal w/a steps; bottom-center golden gate↔two-poop chamber; top-center alcove↔tutorial. Two-poop chamber: two poops flank central rock; faint gray outlined floor tile never opened; key-like sliver appeared and vanished without raising the counter; TECH X pedestal; dead end otherwise. Dark stone room: left exit↔tutorial; red-barred chests and a spiked chest in a damaging white spike cross; floor holes (likely pits); spiders spawn; extremely punishing—avoid early. Shop (via hub keyhole when it works): keeper top-center with gray pot—shooting near it angers it; goods bomb 5¢, card 15¢; right gold-handled door back to hub.

FAILED/CAUTION (observed): the hub's left gold keyhole door did NOT open this run despite holding 1 key, full overlap at its center, and the room being cleared—earlier run it was walked through without consuming a key. Treat as locked/one-way on some runs; don't sink time into it. Attacking the boss-room statue or embedded eye-faces. Shooting TNT barrels, crates, rock rings/clusters. Approaching the brazier-ring chest. Assuming chests won't hurt. Lingering in green clouds, smoke, or brazier fire. Fighting fatties head-on at low hearts—kiting/circling the open side of the room with aligned strafe-fire was the only working pattern; cornering is lethal. Repeatedly bombing/firing at the TNT-room bomb-bug with well-aligned vertical lanes failed to visibly damage it—possibly tear-immune or a very small hitbox; don't commit many shots. Single presses on doors/hatches.
